gate_run.$comment: run_name is exactly tccbin-native-gate/<consumer_id> or tccbin-v-smoke/<consumer_id>. external_id is SHA-256(JCS({schema_version:1,audience,consumer_id,subject_hash,run_id,run_attempt})), where audience is vlang/tccbin:native-gate-check:v1 or vlang/tccbin:v-smoke-check:v1; semantic validation binds every App, actor, workflow, ref, SHA, ID and sanitized URL to the enclosing target state.

v_smoke_dispatch_reservation.$comment: A durable CAS reservation written before any Actions side effect. facts_digest is SHA-256(JCS({schema_version:1,audience:vlang/v:tccbin-v-smoke-dispatch:v1,consumer and subject/workflow authority fields from the enclosing execution}+this object excluding facts_digest)).

v_smoke_attempt.$comment: Each item chains one durable dispatch reservation to one immutable Actions ACK followed by zero or one terminal completion. actor and triggering_actor are validator-dispatcher[bot]. ack_facts_digest covers dispatch_facts_digest and all observed fields through ack_operation_id. completion_facts_digest covers completion_kind, the ACK digest and every terminal run/check field. Check fields are all-null when no validator check exists.

oneOf.$comment: ACKed run is still active
Actions supplied a terminal conclusion, with either no check or one complete check
terminal Actions run with no validator check (infrastructure retry evidence)
terminal Actions run with the complete validator check projection
The selected run remained nonterminal at the persisted 90-minute deadline; no GitHub conclusion is invented

v_smoke_run_absent_attempt.$comment: A durable logical dispatch that exhausted its bounded run-discovery window without fabricating an Actions run. facts_digest is SHA-256(JCS({schema_version:1,audience:vlang/v:tccbin-v-smoke-run-absent:v1,consumer_id,subject_hash}+this object excluding facts_digest)).

v_smoke_execution.$comment: run_name is exactly tccbin-v-smoke/<consumer_id>. external_id is SHA-256(JCS({schema_version:1,audience:vlang/tccbin:v-smoke-check:v1,consumer_id,subject_hash,run_id,run_attempt})). run_absent_attempts retain logical dispatches that produced no Actions ACK, with audience vlang/v:tccbin-v-smoke-run-absent:v1. replay_facts_digest is SHA-256(JCS(the complete execution object excluding replay_facts_digest)); block_facts_digest uses audience vlang/v:tccbin-v-smoke-block:v1 and covers consumer_id, subject_hash, operation, reason and time.

oneOf.$comment: initial pending reservation
initial dispatch durably reserved before an Actions ACK
retry pending after the initial dispatch produced no Actions run to acknowledge
retry pending with first terminal infrastructure attempt retained
second dispatch reserved after the initial dispatch produced no Actions run
second dispatch reserved after the first ACKed infrastructure attempt
first selected Actions run is active
second and final selected Actions run is active
second selected Actions run is active after the first dispatch produced no run
terminal first attempt
terminal second attempt
terminal second attempt after the first dispatch produced no run
blocked before any Actions ACK
blocked after the one create-only retry also produced no Actions run
blocked before the second ACK after the first dispatch produced no run
blocked before the second Actions ACK after retaining the one terminal infrastructure attempt
blocked after a retained first infrastructure run and a second dispatch with no run

native_validation_record.$comment: Replayable T2c2 fact. validation_digest is SHA-256(JCS(the complete object excluding validation_digest plus audience vlang/v:tccbin-native-validation-record:v1)). manifest_hash binds the exact manifest_source bytes; matrix_digest binds JCS(native_lane_matrix); capsule_digest binds manifest, subject, matrix and the sorted exact evidence projection.
